content:
# Edit this file, then run: Rscript scripts/build_boba_app.R
# Base R graphics keeps browser downloads small. All amounts are AUD.
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
blue <- "#4682B4"
coral <- "#F08080"
red <- "#B22222"
ui <- page_fluid(
  theme=bs_theme(version=5, primary="#006DAE", base_font=font_collection("Fira Sans", "Arial", "sans-serif")),
  tags$head(tags$script(HTML('$(document).on("shiny:connected", () => window.parent.postMessage({bobaReady:true},location.origin)); window.addEventListener("message", function(event) { if(event.origin === window.location.origin && ["sample", "sampling", "ci"].includes(event.data?.bobaTab)) { Shiny.setInputValue("requestedTab", event.data.bobaTab, {priority:"event"}); } });')),
    tags$style(HTML('
      body {color:#171717;background:white;font-size:16px;padding:4px 12px;}
      .card {box-shadow:none;} .card-header {background:white;}
      .controls {display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.7fr 1fr 1fr 1.3fr;gap:20px;align-items:center;}
      .form-group {margin-bottom:0;} .actions {display:flex;gap:8px;} .actions .btn {white-space:nowrap;padding:8px 12px;}
      .bslib-value-box {border-left:4px solid #4682B4;background:#f4f7fa!important;color:#171717!important;}
      .bslib-value-box .value-box-title {font-size:15px!important;}
      .bslib-value-box .value-box-value {font-size:25px!important;}
      .bslib-value-box .value-box-area {padding:8px 14px!important;}
      .cards {margin-bottom:0;} .bslib-value-box {min-height:70px!important;height:70px!important;} .value-box-grid {padding:0!important;} .card-body {gap:6px;} .note {font-size:14px;color:#555;margin:4px 0;}
      #samplePlot {height:calc(100vh - 315px)!important;}
      #samplingPlot {height:calc(100vh - 245px)!important;}
      #ciPlot {height:calc(100vh - 280px)!important;}
      .nav-link {color:#444;} .nav-link.active {color:#006DAE!important;font-weight:bold;}
    '))),
  navset_card_tab(id="view", selected="sample",
    header=card_body(padding=c("8px", "16px"), fill=FALSE,
      div(class="controls",
        sliderInput("n", "Cups per sample (n)", min=5, max=200, value=30, step=1),
        numericInput("mu", "Population mean (AUD)", value=8, min=.01, step=.1),
        numericInput("sigma", "Population SD (AUD)", value=1.2, min=.01, step=.1),
        div(class="actions", actionButton("draw", "Simulate prices", class="btn-primary"), actionButton("reset", "Reset")))),
    nav_panel("Sample", value="sample", uiOutput("cards"), plotOutput("samplePlot", height="220px")),
    nav_panel("Sampling Distribution", value="sampling", uiOutput("historySummary"), plotOutput("samplingPlot", height="270px")),
    nav_panel("Confidence Interval", value="ci", uiOutput("ciSummary"), plotOutput("ciPlot", height="260px"),
      div(class="note", "95% t interval: sample mean ± t(0.975, n − 1) × s / √n.")))
)
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  observeEvent(input$requestedTab, nav_select("view", selected=input$requestedTab, session=session))
  # Retain raw prices and statistics for every draw in this session.
  history <- reactiveVal(list())
  latest <- reactive({ req(length(history()) > 0); tail(history(), 1)[[1]]$prices })
  observeEvent(list(input$n, input$mu, input$sigma, input$reset), {
    history(list())
  }, priority=10)
  observeEvent(input$draw, {
    req(is.finite(input$mu), is.finite(input$sigma), input$sigma > 0)
    x <- rnorm(input$n, input$mu, input$sigma)
    se <- sd(x)/sqrt(length(x))
    record <- list(prices=x, mean=mean(x), sd=sd(x), se=se,
      ci=mean(x)+c(-1,1)*qt(.975,length(x)-1)*se)
    history(append(history(), list(record)))
  })
  sampleStats <- reactive({
    req(length(history()) > 0)
    tail(history(), 1)[[1]]
  })
  money <- function(x) sprintf("$%.2f", x)
  output$cards <- renderUI({
    if (length(history()) == 0) return(p("Choose your settings, then click Simulate prices."))
    s <- sampleStats()
    div(class="cards", layout_columns(col_widths=c(4,4,4), gap="12px", fill=FALSE,
      value_box("Sample mean (x̄)", money(s$mean), theme="light", fill=FALSE),
      value_box("Sample SD (s)", money(s$sd), theme="light", fill=FALSE),
      value_box("Estimated SE (s / √n)", money(s$se), theme="light", fill=FALSE)))
  })
  plotStyle <- function() par(mar=c(4.2,4.2,1.2,1), mgp=c(2.6,.7,0), cex=1.25, fg="#737373", col.axis="#171717", col.lab="#171717", family="sans")
  output$samplePlot <- renderPlot({
    validate(need(length(history()) > 0, "Draw a sample to see its prices."))
    plotStyle(); x <- latest(); s <- sampleStats()
    bins <- hist(x, breaks="Scott", plot=FALSE)
    width <- diff(bins$breaks)[1]
    grid <- seq(min(bins$breaks), max(bins$breaks), length.out=500)
    fitted <- dnorm(grid,s$mean,s$sd)*length(x)*width
    plot(bins, freq=TRUE, col=adjustcolor(blue,.65), border="white", main="",
      xlab="Boba price (AUD)", ylab="Count", ylim=c(0,max(bins$counts,fitted)))
    lines(grid, fitted, col=blue, lwd=3)
  }, res=110)
  output$historySummary <- renderUI({
    p(strong(paste(length(history()), "simulated samples")), " | All fitted sample distributions; latest draw highlighted")
  })
  output$samplingPlot <- renderPlot({
    validate(need(length(history()) > 0, "Draw a sample to compare the distributions."))
    plotStyle(); draws <- history(); k <- length(draws)
    limits <- range(c(input$mu+c(-4,4)*input$sigma,
      unlist(lapply(draws,function(s) s$mean+c(-4,4)*s$sd))))
    grid <- seq(limits[1],limits[2],length.out=600)
    population <- dnorm(grid,input$mu,input$sigma)
    curves <- vapply(draws,function(s) dnorm(grid,s$mean,s$sd), numeric(length(grid)))
    plot(grid,population,type="n",yaxt="n",ylab="",bty="n",
      xlab="Boba price (AUD)",ylim=c(0,max(population,curves)*1.15))
    if(k>1) matlines(grid,curves[,seq_len(k-1),drop=FALSE],col=adjustcolor(blue,.3),lty=1,lwd=1.5)
    lines(grid,curves[,k],col=blue,lwd=3)
    lines(grid,population,col=coral,lwd=3)
    legend("topright",c("Population distribution","Sample distributions","Latest sample"),
      lty=1,col=c(coral,adjustcolor(blue,.4),blue),lwd=c(3,1.5,3),bty="n",cex=.8)
  }, res=110)
  output$ciSummary <- renderUI({
    if(length(history()) == 0) return(p("Draw a sample to estimate the population mean."))
    s <- sampleStats(); captured <- s$ci[1]<=input$mu && s$ci[2]>=input$mu
    captures <- vapply(history(),function(d) d$ci[1]<=input$mu && d$ci[2]>=input$mu,logical(1))
    p(sprintf("%s intervals | %s contain μ (%.1f%%). Latest: [%s, %s]. ",
      length(captures),sum(captures),100*mean(captures),money(s$ci[1]),money(s$ci[2])),
      strong(style=paste0("color:",if(captured) blue else red),if(captured) "Contains μ." else "Misses μ."))
  })
  output$ciPlot <- renderPlot({
    validate(need(length(history()) > 0, "Draw a sample to see its confidence interval."))
    plotStyle(); draws <- history(); k <- length(draws)
    means <- vapply(draws, `[[`, numeric(1), "mean")
    lower <- vapply(draws,function(d) d$ci[1],numeric(1))
    upper <- vapply(draws,function(d) d$ci[2],numeric(1))
    captures <- lower<=input$mu & upper>=input$mu
    colours <- ifelse(captures,blue,red)
    ids <- seq_len(k)
    plot(NA,xlim=extendrange(c(lower,upper,input$mu),f=.1),ylim=c(.5,k+max(5,k*.45)),
      yaxt="n",ylab="Draw",xlab="Mean boba price (AUD)",bty="n")
    axis(2,at=if(k<=10) ids else pretty(ids)[pretty(ids)>=1 & pretty(ids)<=k],las=1)
    abline(v=input$mu,lty=2,col=coral,lwd=3)
    segments(lower,ids,upper,ids,col=colours,lwd=ifelse(ids==k,4,2))
    points(means,ids,pch=19,col=colours,cex=ifelse(ids==k,1.2,.8))
    legend("topright",c(paste("Population mean",money(input$mu)),"Contains μ","Misses μ"),
      col=c(coral,blue,red),lty=c(2,1,1),lwd=2,bty="n",cex=.8)
  },res=110)
}
shinyApp(ui, server)
